newsitem.title: USA: American Radio to pay $3m for Ohio station.
newsitem.headline: American Radio to pay $3m for Ohio station.

text.p: American Radio Systems Corp said Friday it reached an agreement to buy radio station WMMA-FM, in Lebanon, Ohio, from privately-held McMurray Communications for $3 million.

George Otwell of Media Venture Partners brokered the transaction, which is subject to regulatory approval. American Radio also said it has options and agreements to buy other radio stations in Portland, San Francisco, Pittsburgh and West Palm Beach, Fla., and Riverside, Calif.
